mapper.select: SELECT id, travel_plan_item_id, alternative_order, condition_label, content, tag, created_by_member_id, version, created_at, updated_at FROM travel_plan_item_alternatives WHERE travel_plan_item_id = #{travelPlanItemId} ORDER BY alternative_order ASC

SELECT a.id, a.travel_plan_item_id, a.alternative_order, a.condition_label, a.content, a.tag, a.created_by_member_id, a.version, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM travel_plan_item_alternatives a JOIN travel_plan_items i ON i.id = a.travel_plan_item_id JOIN travel_plan_days d ON d.id = i.travel_plan_day_id WHERE d.travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} ORDER BY a.travel_plan_item_id ASC, a.alternative_order ASC
